description: Phase-2 turnaround concepts: clean 3/4 poses, full creature, flat pale bg, all features visible. Pall + Brood bare-trigger on the installed v3 @1.5 (their clean classes). 3 variations each to pick the best mesh input.

defaults.negative: text, watermark, frame, border, signature, multiple creatures, busy background, scenery, cropped, cut off

subjects.prompt: a creature concept, a single sagging flying creature at a clear three-quarter front angle, both uneven wings of cracked amber tallow on yellow-brown bone struts fully spread and visible, a smooth featureless pale head-bulb, the whole creature centered and fully in frame, a flat plain pale grey background

a creature concept, a single clotted heap of fused rounded amber tallow grub-bodies bound in a net of dark strands with charred black stubs, seen at a three-quarter angle, the whole mass centered and fully in frame, a flat plain pale grey background
